title: form draft links new tab named in link
rule: In-form links that must not lose the draft open in a new tab, and say so in the link text — `target="_blank"` plus visible “(opent in een nieuwe tab)” (or icon + equivalent SR text inside the link). Dual-cite USWDS identify-destination; this is draft-preservation + in-link announcement.
pass_when: Draft-preserving form links use `target="_blank"` and name the new tab in the link’s visible/SR text.
fail_when: A form link opens a new tab with no in-link announcement, or a same-tab link drops the draft with no new-tab path when the source required it.
overview: Draft-preserving form links open in a new tab and say so in the link text.
apply_when: Linking out from a form where leaving the tab would lose the draft.
not_when: Not for ordinary same-tab navigation that intentionally leaves a saved form.
agent_hint: Use target=_blank and name the new tab in visible or SR link text.
description: In-form links that must not lose the draft open in a new tab (`target="_blank"`) and say so in the link’s visible or screen-reader text—for example “(opent in een nieuwe tab)” or an icon with equivalent SR text inside the link. Fail if a form link opens a new tab with no in-link announcement, or if a same-tab link drops the draft when the source required a new-tab path.
do_not_claim: USWDS identify-destination as a merge that drops draft-preservation; labels-only-text as this row.
